//: An editor-facing mirror of tsconfig.plugins-web.json, which is the config the repository gate actually runs (it type-checks every plugin's browser sources, embeddable widget included, in one pass). Kept here so opening this folder in an editor uses the same settings instead of inventing its own: esbuild STRIPS types without checking them, and this bundle is served to third-party websites, where a mistake ships to somebody else's page.
